title: AI Video Drama Platform — Structured Storyboard to ComfyUI and FFmpeg
purpose: 將故事大綱轉為經 Pydantic 驗證的分鏡，再以本機 ComfyUI 生成逐場圖片並透過 FFmpeg 組成 MP4。
recommendation: 適合參考 LLM Structured Outputs → typed storyboard → ComfyUI REST/WebSocket → FFmpeg 的分層架構。現階段沒有瀏覽器前端，預設是圖片合成影片而非真正 text-to-video；Kandinsky T2V workflow 僅供檢視、尚未接入執行。
notes: README calls this v0.1 backend skeleton. CLI supports story-to-MP4 or manual storyboard without OpenAI key; FastAPI endpoint currently generates validated storyboard JSON only. character_ref and dialogue are metadata, not wired to IP-Adapter/TTS. API key is user-supplied; live tests opt-in. No license declared in GitHub repository metadata.
